steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units on the line to Vendor B.
Verify the full line is allocated to one vendor and the proposal value is 90 × 10 = 900.
Open the proposal form after allocating the award.

args.goal: On the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1 Contact Name, leave that field empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop when the form shows the required-field refusal.

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately omitting the field under test, then attempt submission.
Assert that the omitted contact-name field is highlighted with the required-field validation and submission is refused.
